EX-99.1 4 dwtx-ex99d1.htm EX-99.1 ​ Exhibit 99.1 Dogwood Announces $5 Million Private Placement with CK Life Sciences Int’l., (Holdings) Inc. - Largest Shareholder Increases Position as Dogwood Advances Halneuron® Toward Topline Phase 2b Data Readout in November 2026 - - Expected Proceeds from the Investment Enable Acceleration of Phase 3 Preparatory Activities - ​ ATLANTA, Ga., October 19, 2026 -- Dogwood Therapeutics, Inc.
The investment comes as Dogwood continues to advance its ongoing Halneuron® Phase 2b Chemotherapy Induced Neuropathic Pain (“CINP”) trial toward topline data readout in November 2026.

We look forward to reporting topline data from the HAL-CINP trial in the coming weeks and value CK Life Sciences’ deepening commitment to Dogwood and Halneuron®.” Halneuron ® CINP Phase 2b Trial (“HAL-CINP”) Overview (NCT06848348) HAL-CINP is a randomized, phase 2b clinical trial evaluating the efficacy and safety of Halneuron ® compared with placebo in 239 patients with moderate to severe neuropathic pain caused by prior platinum and/or taxane-based chemotherapy.
